# 10 — one GitHub subject, exactly, its owner declared

Case 08's policy, with `github:acme` declared.

**Expected.** Grant 1 → **yours**, exact: the owner declared. The headline is "Nothing outside
your company can assume this role.", as it was before case 08's headline was added.

**Why.** The headline that quotes a subject is said only of the outermost ring reached outside the
reader's company. A declared owner's grant is in the reader's own ring, and nothing outside it is
reached, so the headline says that.
